The dominant cross-month narrative is the **complete FY2026 budget cycle**:

| Phase | Date | Item(s) | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| Preparation | Aug 1-15 | 2025-08-0001, 0002, 0003, 0004 | TRIM notices mailed, tax roll certified, budget workbooks published, calendar set |
| First Hearing | Sep 3 | 2025-09-0001 | Tentative budget presented, public comment taken ($1.8B, first tax cut since FY2021) |

## 6. Tax Bill Cycle Continuity

The tax cycle connects Aug and Sep:

- **Aug**: TRIM notices mailed (proposed values + millage rates), tax roll certified
- **Sep**: Millage rates adopted, tax bills mailed

This is the standard Florida property tax timeline. The Aug-Sep 2025 window captures the complete cycle from notice to bill.
